assets: All art, models and sounds are procedurally generated at runtime (Three.js geometry + WebAudio oscillators). No external assets, no ripped ROM content.

references.what: FC Super Mario Bros. World 1-1 level layout (block/pipe/enemy/flag positions approximated from memory of the original)
references.rights: Nintendo. Referenced as a fan-made homage only; no ROM data, original sprites, music or sounds are used.

bgm: Original 8-bar chiptune loop written for this demo (C major, square lead + triangle bass). Intentionally NOT the Nintendo melody.
